actions.text:
Hi Marcus —

Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. This project sounds like a great fit. I have experience building real-time dashboards and integrating with REST APIs, plus implementing role-based auth and responsive designs (including dark mode). A few quick questions so I can confirm scope and timing:

1) Do you have API docs or a staging endpoint I can review to estimate the integration effort?  
2) For real-time updates, do you prefer WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling?  
3) Any design system or component library you want to use (Material, Chakra, Tailwind, custom)?  
4) Who will own auth currently (do you have an existing identity provider or should I implement auth from scratch)?  
5) Will I be collaborating with a backend engineer on your side or expected to handle backend adjustments if needed?

My availability: I can start planning immediately and commit to a 4-week timeline if the scope aligns. For a project of this size and the deliverables you described, my estimate is $5,500–$6,500 depending on integration complexity and whether backend work is required. I’m happy to hop on a 30-minute call to go over details and lock down milestones.

If that works, please share API docs and a few times that work for a call.

Thanks —
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer / Full-Stack Developer
